ui.common.errors.desktop_refusal.no_cred.role: diagnosis shown when the app holds no credential for the running server
ui.common.errors.desktop_refusal.no_cred.tone: calm factual explanation, sentence case, full stop
ui.common.errors.desktop_refusal.no_cred.note: Composed from the refusal CODE by the renderer transport, never from the daemon's own prose. It states a pairing fact about this app and the server it is talking to; it is not an instruction to restart or reconfigure anything. 'Local Operator' is the product name and stays in English.

ui.common.errors.desktop_refusal.refused.role: diagnosis shown when the running server refused this app's credential
ui.common.errors.desktop_refusal.refused.tone: calm factual explanation, sentence case, full stop
ui.common.errors.desktop_refusal.refused.note: Composed from the refusal code. Names the credential as this app's own and the server as the one running: the fact is that the pairing was rejected, not that the app was never paired. 'Local Operator' is the product name and stays in English.

ui.common.errors.desktop_refusal.plane_c.role: diagnosis shown when the running server does not serve the desktop control plane
ui.common.errors.desktop_refusal.plane_c.tone: calm factual statement, sentence case, full stop
ui.common.errors.desktop_refusal.plane_c.note: Composed from the refusal code; it describes a server started without the desktop controls, which a restart by hand may change - the sentence deliberately gives no instruction. 'Local Operator' is the product name and stays in English.

ui.common.errors.desktop_refusal.transpo.role: diagnosis shown when a desktop control got no answer from the server
ui.common.errors.desktop_refusal.transpo.tone: calm factual statement, sentence case, full stop
ui.common.errors.desktop_refusal.transpo.note: Composed from the refusal code when the request never completed: nothing was established about the server's pairing state, so the sentence claims only that no answer arrived. 'Local Operator' is the product name and stays in English.
